title: Associate Child Development Teacher/Future Educators
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

why: the blocks sum to 9.0-15.0; the catalog states 15.0-15.0

program.section_heading: Associate Child Development Teacher/Future Educators COA
outcomes: Demonstrate knowledge of child growth, development and learning theories in an ecological context, and history of the American Disabilities Act and civil rights addressing the needs of children with disabilities.

Integrate into culture and community through designing, implementing, and evaluating developmentally appropriate, healthy, safe, and inclusive learning environments and curriculum through systematic observation, screening, assessment, documentation of children.

Communicate effectively to develop strategies that promote linguistically and culturally responsive, anti-bias approaches to ensure equity and respect while engaging children, families, teachers, programs, and communities in advocacy for high quality care and education.

Think critically to describe effective guidance and interaction strategies that promote identity development, and relationship-based, child-centered, and play-oriented approaches in support of children and families becoming socially and emotionally competent members of a diverse society.

Excel in the workplace by applying a variety of educational strategies, observing children’s development and learning, planning and facilitating curriculum activities, guiding behavior, and identifying the roles, requirements, and responsibilities of early care and education and eleme

blocks.name: Emphasis: Early Childhood Education - ECE Emphasis
Emphasis: Early Childhood Education - ECE Practicum-Field Experience

notes: 'Complete One Emphasis' (9 units): the Early Childhood Education emphasis is made up of two blocks together (ECE Emphasis, 6 units all required, plus ECE Practicum-Field Experience, 3 units chosen from CHILD16 or CHILD44); the Future Educator Teaching Preparation emphasis is the other option. All three blocks carry option_group 'Complete One Emphasis', but the first two form a single option.
The Future Educator emphasis says 'Complete the following number of units: 9' over three 3-unit courses, so in effect all three are required.
Codes are recorded as the catalog prints them without a space (e.g., CHILD1 = closed-list CHILD 1); all match the closed list.
The fifth program learning outcome is cut off in the source text ('...early care and education and eleme'); recorded as printed, not completed.
An earlier 'Upon satisfactory completion of this award...' lead-in near the description has no outcomes under it; the outcomes come from the Program Learning Outcomes section.
